chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, from his father who said:
I mentioned the House (Kabah) to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), so he said: 'If they were to suspend it for one year, they would not be (given the) Respite (from the Punishment)'.

key_terms.لَمْ يُنَاظَرُوا: They would not be given respite/delayed

ai.seo_question: What happens if people neglect Hajj for one year according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the cosmic significance of the Hajj by stating that a single year of collective neglect would have triggered immediate divine retribution. This underscores the ritual not merely as a personal duty but as a vital pillar of communal spiritual stability, a view supported by Shia exegetes who link it to the concept of 'Hujjah' (divine proof) upon the earth.
